responses.draft_cover_letter:
I have spent the past years building and operating cloud‑native services on AWS, using Terraform to provision production‑grade ECS clusters. In that role I introduced end‑to‑end observability by wiring Prometheus metrics into Grafana dashboards, which gave the team real‑time insight into system health. My Python experience includes designing and delivering REST APIs with FastAPI, providing the automation backbone for several internal tools.

A key accomplishment was reducing incident detection time by half through tighter alerting and automated runbooks, demonstrating a proactive approach to on‑call responsibilities. The same infrastructure work also delivered a reliable, high‑throughput smart‑meter platform that meets strict availability targets.

While I have not yet managed Kubernetes clusters, I am eager to apply my Terraform and AWS expertise to that environment and quickly acquire the operational patterns required. Likewise, I look forward to expanding my on‑call experience to cover full‑cycle incident response, building on the detection improvements I have already delivered.

I am excited about the opportunity to bring this blend of infrastructure automation, observability, and Python‑driven tooling to Halcyon Energy’s smart‑meter platform, and to grow alongside a team that values reliability and continuous improvement.
